thesis: The bear carries the present-entry argument: verified growth has not supplied self-funded expansion or a normalised valuation supporting the premium. This is neutral rather than sell because liquidity and rapid demand growth are substantial counterevidence, and neither failure nor reversal is observed.
strongest_counterexample: Q2 revenue rose 104.8% and attributable profit 202.3%, while RM368.960m cash equivalents exceed RM82.238m borrowings; genuine growth and liquidity could support the investment ramp.
invalidation_conditions: A subsequent comparable half-year reports CFO less PP&E purchases above zero, alongside positive year-on-year revenue and tax-normalised earnings growth, removing the observed cash-conversion obstacle.
Conversely, subsequent comparable revenue or tax-normalised earnings growth at or below zero while CFO less PP&E remains negative would defeat the retained growth option.
evidence_gaps: Tax-normalised recurring earnings and investment/working-capital returns.
Matched valuation and sustainable post-investment cash; undated vendor statements cannot establish trends.
decisive_factors: 93.83x vendor trailing reference has no matched fair-value support.
RSI 89.3701 and upper-band extension limit entry confidence without predicting reversal.
